positions.title: Engineering Manager, Team Lead
positions.description:
Led a high-performing, globally distributed team of 7 full-stack software engineers:

• Conducted biweekly 1:1s focused on mentoring, performance development, and long-term career growth.
• Managed the full employee lifecycle, including hiring, performance reviews, promotions, and terminations; delivered biannual reviews and compensation adjustments.
• Acted as Scrum Master, fostering agile best practices and enabling effective cross-functional collaboration with product, design, and executive teams.
• Played a strategic advisory role in executive leadership meetings, influencing product direction and organizational priorities.
• Spearheaded the end-to-end development of an energy utility data REST API with subscription billing using Python, Django REST Framework, and AWS.
• Improved system reliability by implementing AWS monitoring, increasing automated test coverage to 80%, and leading structured postmortems to reduce emergency incidents.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
• Accelerated team productivity by onboarding and mentoring new engineers, enabling faster contributions and smoother team integration.
• Increased ARR by 50%+ by delivering a custom accrual accounting projection system and reporting suite to secure a high-value client; built with Python, JavaScript, and PostgreSQL.
• Empowered the team to rapidly deliver new financial dashboards by architecting a reusable framework using Python, JavaScript, and Highcharts.
• Reduced development cycle time by enhancing the DevOps pipeline, a custom CI/CD system using Python, Buildbot, EC2, and an internal Fabric fork.
• Co-led a major front-end redesign to make the platform fully responsive, leveraging Django Suit 2 and Bootstrap 5 for a modern, mobile-friendly UI.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technical Lead on mission-critical projects for a Django-based back-office platform at an early-stage energy tech startup (team of 4 engineers):

• Led development of a customizable data escrow feature that allowed clients to automatically retain data exports on their preferred cloud storage service (initially via Python and Dropbox API and architected for easy extension to support additional providers), helping close key sales by addressing data ownership and portability concerns.
• Improved reporting accuracy, performance, and code quality by architecting a new reporting framework using Python, Django, and PostgreSQL, enhancing maintainability and test coverage.
• Delivered a high-impact feature for modeling complex, contract-specific cash revenue schedules, integrated with the payments system to reconcile expected vs. received payments.
• Cut CI build time in half, from 40 minutes to under 20, by refactoring and optimizing the automated test suite.
• Upgraded core Linux server infrastructure, including Python, Django, and OS versions, ensuring long-term stability and security.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.locationName: Blue Bell, Pennsylvania, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Enhanced speed and reliability of a core ETL application using Python, Django ORM, and PostgreSQL, improving data pipeline performance and system stability.
• Boosted sales by building robust web scrapers to automate high-volume file transfers from and to various data sources using PycURL, requests, and BeautifulSoup.
• Developed client-facing data analytics dashboards and custom reports using Klipfolio, enabling better insight delivery and stakeholder visibility.

positions.title: Senior Project Coordinator
positions.locationName: Blue Bell, Pennsylvania, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Managed a global Phase III Alzheimer’s disease clinical trial across 17 countries, overseeing cross-functional coordination and stakeholder engagement.:

• Rebuilt client trust after prior manager’s removal by initiating weekly client-facing teleconferences with data-driven presentations highlighting key trial metrics and risk areas.
• Ensured trial milestones were met by coordinating efforts across regulatory, data management, and biostatistics teams.
• Oversaw development and localization of recruitment and retention materials in 15 languages, distributed to over 200 research sites worldwide.
• Increased patient enrollment through a newly developed marketing initiative tailored to site-specific recruitment challenges.

positions.title: Clinical Supply Associate
positions.locationName: West Point, Pennsylvania, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Led rotating 2-person teams to execute clinical trial work orders with precision under multiple daily deadlines.:

• Consistently maintained compliance by completing and reviewing GMP documentation with zero deviations.
• Improved operational efficiency by collaborating with supervisors to redesign the work order scheduling system.
